name: com.limpo.ai-sprite-animation
description: Animate a 2D sprite from a single image inside the Unity editor. Default Rig method moves the sprite's own pixels through a bone hierarchy (independent arms, legs, weapon; pixel-exact, instant). Optional beta AI Pose + Rig lets AI generate the motion (AnimateDiff video + SDPose pose estimation, via a local ComfyUI) while the rig still renders the original pixels; experimental AI Redraw redraws frames with AnimateDiff. Imports frames as sprites and builds an AnimationClip.
